current_detections.name: Liquidity Sweep
current_detections.evidence: Price spiked down to approximately 552-553 near the 08:00 area, sweeping below recent swing lows, followed by a sharp recovery candle back toward 558-560.
current_detections.missing_conditions: Sustained follow-through buying above the sweep high to confirm institutional absorption and invalidate further downside.

current_detections.name: Double Top
